title: RowShareAssessment
description: The assessment attached to a request for a row share (data layer phase 10). The server fills it with its own checks, with no model: counts, field names, category ids, and the days asked for against the setting. An agent or a person may add the narrative later. It holds no record value and no row id. It never approves or refuses: a person decides.

source.description: Who made the structured parts. The narrative says who wrote it, when it is filled.

fits.description: Whether the justification fits the policy. The server cannot judge words, so it writes not_assessed. An agent or a person may change it with the narrative.

characters.description: The length of the justification. Its words are not copied here.

rows_inside_default.description: Rows the grantee already does this on.

rows_restricted.description: Rows whose label asks something of a reader that the grantee does not meet.

categories.description: Category ids the named rows and fields carry.

narrative.description: A slot for a short assessment written by an agent or a person after the request is filed. Null until then.
